scope: Local reviewed M68 candidate; hosted delivery pending

source_artifacts.text:
name: Verify

on:
  pull_request:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  contents: read

concurrency:
  group: verify-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

jobs:
  native-postgres:
    name: Native PostgreSQL worksheet and tenant regression
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 10
    services:
      postgres:
        image: postgres:17
        env:
          POSTGRES_USER: m63_test_admin
          POSTGRES_DB: m63_integration
          POSTGRES_HOST_AUTH_METHOD: trust
        ports:
          - 55463:5432
        options: >-
          --health-cmd "pg_isready -U m63_test_admin -d m63_integration"
          --health-interval 5s
          --health-timeout 5s
          --health-retries 10
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: oven-sh/setup-bun@v2
        with:
          bun-version: 1.3.12
      - run: bun install --frozen-lockfile
      - name: Initialize and challenge isolated PostgreSQL roles and storage
        run: bun test packages/neuvetra-database/src/hosted.test.ts
        env:
          M63_TEST_DATABASE_URL: postgres://m63_test_admin@127.0.0.1:55463/m63_integration
      - name: Verify staged HTTP and frontend decoding against PostgreSQL
        run: bun test apps/site-api/src/staging/postgres.test.ts apps/site-api/src/workspace/m66-postgres.test.ts apps/site-api/src/workspace/m67-postgres.test.ts apps/site-api/src/workspace/m68-postgres.test.ts
        env:
          M63_API_TEST_DATABASE_URL: postgres://m63_test_admin@127.0.0.1:55463/m63_integration

  applications:
    name: Typecheck, lint, unit tests and web builds
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 15
    env:
      TURBO_TELEMETRY_DISABLED: "1"
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: oven-sh/setup-bun@v2
        with:
          bun-version: 1.3.12
      - run: bun install --frozen-lockfile
      - run: bun run check
      - name: Independent source-linked worksheet decoder and report cases
        run: bun test evaluations/research-qa/m66-independent-frontend.test.ts evaluations/research-qa/m66-independent-renderer.test.ts
      - name: Independent annual worksheet decoder, renderer and print-action cases
        run: bun test evaluations/research-qa/m67-independent-frontend.test.ts evaluations/research-qa/m67-independent-renderer.test.ts evaluations/research-qa/m67-independent-print-view.test.ts
      - name: Independent annual evidence decoder, UI, print-action and packaging cases
        run: bun test evaluations/research-qa/m68-independent-frontend.test.ts evaluations/research-qa/m68-independent-print-view.test.ts evaluations/research-qa/m68-independent-ui.test.ts
      - name: Offline cloud database boundary tests
        run: bun test tools/cloud/database-inventory.test.ts tools/cloud/apply-development.test.ts tools/cloud/data-api-exposure.test.ts tools/cloud/activate-synthetic.test.ts tools/cloud/website-publication.test.ts tools/cloud/check-website-reader.test.ts tools/research/evaluate-website-cloud.test.ts tools/research/evaluate-website-composed.test.ts tools/research/cloud-read-diagnostics.test.ts tools/research/cloud-fetch-injection.test.ts
      - name: Typecheck cloud database helper
        run: bun node_modules/typescript/bin/tsc --noEmit --module esnext --moduleResolution bundler --target es2022 --types bun --strict --skipLibCheck tools/cloud/database-inventory.ts tools/cloud/database-inventory.test.ts tools/cloud/apply-development.ts tools/cloud/apply-development.test.ts tools/cloud/data-api-exposure.ts tools/cloud/data-api-exposure.test.ts tools/cloud/activate-synthetic.ts tools/cloud/activate-synthetic.test.ts tools/cloud/website-publication.ts tools/cloud/website-publication.test.ts tools/cloud/check-website-reader.ts tools/cloud/check-website-reader.test.ts tools/research/evaluate-website-cloud.ts tools/research/evaluate-website-cloud.test.ts tools/research/evaluate-website-composed.ts tools/research/evaluate-website-composed.test.ts tools/research/evaluate-website-questions.ts tools/research/cloud-read-diagnostics.ts tools/research/cloud-read-diagnostics.test.ts tools/research/cloud-fetch-injection.test.ts

  staging-image:
    name: Dedicated staging image and offline runtime smoke
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 15
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - name: Build explicit combined image without provider credentials
        run: docker build --platform linux/amd64 --file Dockerfile.staging --tag neuvetra-m63:${{ github.sha }} .
      - name: Verify runtime imports, pinned assets, Python and actual HTTP listener offline
        run: |
          docker run --rm --network none --entrypoint bun neuvetra-m63:${{ github.sha }} -e '
            import {createStagingServer} from "/app/apps/site-api/src/staging/server.ts";
            import {readStagingConfig,STAGING_PROFILE} from "/app/apps/site-api/src/staging/config.ts";
            import {runEngine} from "/app/apps/site-api/src/calculation/server.ts";
            const {readMigrationManifest}=await import("/app/packages/neuvetra-database/src/staging-migrations.ts");
            const manifest=await readMigrationManifest();if(manifest.length!==14||manifest[13].name!=="0014_annual_electricity_evidence.sql")throw new Error("Incomplete image migration manifest");
            const ref="abcdefghijklmnopqrst";
            const config=readStagingConfig({NODE_ENV:"test",NEUVETRA_STAGING_ENABLED:"enabled",NEUVETRA_STAGING_PROFILE:STAGING_PROFILE,NEUVETRA_STAGING_PROJECT_REF:ref,NEUVETRA_STAGING_ORIGIN:"http://127.0.0.1:8080",SUPABASE_URL:`https://${ref}.supabase.co`,SUPABASE_ANON_KEY:"sb_publishable_synthetic_fixture_not_a_real_key",DATABASE_URL:`postgres://neuvetra_runtime:fixture@db.${ref}.supabase.co:5432/postgres`});
            const database={checkReadiness:async()=>({profile:STAGING_PROFILE,schemaVersion:14}),close:async()=>{}};
            const app=await createStagingServer(config,{database,validateUser:async()=>null,log:()=>{}});
            const server=Bun.serve({hostname:"127.0.0.1",port:8080,fetch:app.fetch});
            try {
              for(const route of ["/health","/ready","/","/workspace-api/config"]) {const r=await fetch(`http://127.0.0.1:8080${route}`);if(r.status!==200||r.headers.get("cache-control")!=="no-store")throw new Error("Image HTTP smoke failed");await r.arrayBuffer();}
              const index=await (await fetch("http://127.0.0.1:8080/")).text();
              const scripts=[...index.matchAll(/src="([^"]+\.js)"/g)].map(m=>m[1]);
              if(scripts.length===0)throw new Error("No built staging application");
              for(const src of scripts){if(!src.startsWith("/assets/"))throw new Error("External application script");const r=await fetch(`http://127.0.0.1:8080${src}`);if(r.status!==200)throw new Error("Missing staged bundle");await r.arrayBuffer();}
              for(const route of ["/.env","/apps/site-api/src/staging/server.ts","/tools/research/m43-heldout-first-batch-v1.json"])if((await fetch(`http://127.0.0.1:8080${route}`)).status!==404)throw new Error("Non-public path exposed");
              if((await fetch("http://127.0.0.1:8080/workspace-api/session")).status!==401)throw new Error("Authentication boundary failed");
              const uuid="11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111";
              const binding={company_id:uuid,evidence_id:uuid,bill_version_id:uuid,activity_version_id:uuid,facility_id:uuid,boundary_id:uuid,bill_version:2,activity_version:1,extraction_id:uuid,parser_version:"m55-fixed-pdf-v1",previous_bill_version_id:uuid,evidence_sha256:"0a97cd0976c03af0776214fc19bdc3d4f0c00e9c835f3e116574a6f375c8e135",source_quantity_kwh:"12346.000",normalized_quantity_mwh:"12.346000",correction_reason:"Synthetic review exercise",service_period:{start:"2023-01-01",end:"2023-01-31"},facility:{name:"Synthetic California office",country:"United States",state:"California",egrid_subregion:"CAMX"},boundary:{reporting_year:2023,approach:"operational_control",status:"draft",version:1}};
              const calculation=await runEngine({action:"calculate_linked_bill",binding});
              if(calculation.status!=="ok"||calculation.record?.total?.unrounded!=="2407.9674055248")throw new Error("Container Decimal calculation failed");
              console.info(JSON.stringify({imageSmoke:"passed",database:"injected_offline",authentication:"refusal_only",calculation:"real_python",assets:"hash_verified"}));
            } finally {await server.stop(true);await app.close();}
          '
      - name: Refuse ordinary container startup without explicit staging configuration
        run: |
          if docker run --rm --network none neuvetra-m63:${{ github.sha }}; then
            echo "Container unexpectedly started without staging configuration"
            exit 1
          fi
      - name: Record exact local image identity
        run: docker image inspect neuvetra-m63:${{ github.sha }} --format '{{.Id}}'

  research-catalog:
    name: Offline research catalog tests
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 5
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-python@v7
        with:
          python-version: '3.12'
      - run: python -m unittest discover -s tools/research -p "test_*.py" -v
      - name: Offline cloud evidence boundary tests
        run: python -B -m unittest discover -s tools/cloud -p "test_*.py" -v

  ghg-calculations:
    name: GHG calculation specifications and engine
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 5
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: oven-sh/setup-bun@v2
        with:
          bun-version: 1.3.12
      - uses: actions/setup-python@v7
        with:
          python-version: '3.12'
      - run: python -m pip install --disable-pip-version-check pint==0.26 pytest==9.1.1 pyyaml==6.0.3
      - run: bun run test:ghg

# Dedicated combined M63 image. Build from the repository root with this file;
# Dockerfile.staging.dockerignore is the matching deny-by-default context filter.
# This does not alter the ordinary Site/FrontDesk Dockerfiles or enable flags.
FROM oven/bun:1.3.12 AS workspace
WORKDIR /app
COPY package.json bun.lock ./
COPY apps/frontdesk-api/package.json ./apps/frontdesk-api/
COPY apps/frontdesk-web/package.json ./apps/frontdesk-web/
COPY apps/site-api/package.json ./apps/site-api/
COPY apps/site-web/package.json ./apps/site-web/
COPY apps/terrascope-api/package.json ./apps/terrascope-api/
COPY apps/terrascope-web/package.json ./apps/terrascope-web/
COPY packages/frontdesk-config/package.json ./packages/frontdesk-config/
COPY packages/frontdesk-database/package.json ./packages/frontdesk-database/
COPY packages/neuvetra-database/package.json ./packages/neuvetra-database/
COPY packages/terrascope-config/package.json ./packages/terrascope-config/
COPY packages/terrascope-database/package.json ./packages/terrascope-database/
COPY packages/terrascope-calculator/package.json ./packages/terrascope-calculator/

FROM workspace AS web-build
RUN bun install --frozen-lockfile --filter site-web
COPY tsconfig.base.json ./
COPY config/typescript/ ./config/typescript/
COPY apps/site-web/tsconfig.json apps/site-web/tsconfig.app.json apps/site-web/tsconfig.node.json apps/site-web/vite.config.ts apps/site-web/vite.staging.config.ts apps/site-web/staging.html ./apps/site-web/
COPY apps/site-web/scripts/finalize-staging.ts ./apps/site-web/scripts/
COPY apps/site-web/src/ ./apps/site-web/src/
COPY packages/neuvetra-database/src/m64-contract.ts packages/neuvetra-database/src/m65-contract.ts packages/neuvetra-database/src/m65-template.ts packages/neuvetra-database/src/m66-contract.ts packages/neuvetra-database/src/m66-template.ts packages/neuvetra-database/src/m66-fixtures.ts packages/neuvetra-database/src/m67-contract.ts packages/neuvetra-database/src/m67-template.ts packages/neuvetra-database/src/m68-contract.ts packages/neuvetra-database/src/m68-template.ts ./packages/neuvetra-database/src/
# Full web typechecking resolves this reviewed catalog; it is not a runtime corpus.
COPY data/research/answer-units/scope2-website.epa-acquisition.v1.json ./data/research/answer-units/
COPY output/pdf/neuvetra-m55-synthetic-electricity-bill.pdf output/pdf/neuvetra-m66-synthetic-electricity-bill-b.pdf ./output/pdf/
RUN bun run --filter site-web build:staging

FROM workspace AS production-dependencies
RUN bun install --frozen-lockfile --production --filter site-api

FROM python:3.12.11-slim-bookworm AS runtime
WORKDIR /app
ENV NODE_ENV=production \
    PORT=8080 \
    NEUVETRA_PYTHON=/usr/local/bin/python \
    NEUVETRA_STAGING_WEB_ROOT=/app/apps/site-web/dist-staging \
    NEUVETRA_STAGING_DB_CA_FILE=/app/tools/cloud/fixtures/supabase-prod-ca-2021.crt \
    PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 \
    PYTHONUNBUFFERED=1
COPY --from=workspace /usr/local/bin/bun /usr/local/bin/bun
COPY --from=production-dependencies /app/ ./
COPY tsconfig.base.json ./
COPY config/typescript/ ./config/typescript/
COPY apps/site-api/tsconfig.json ./apps/site-api/
COPY apps/site-api/src/staging/server.ts apps/site-api/src/staging/config.ts apps/site-api/src/staging/assets.ts ./apps/site-api/src/staging/
COPY apps/site-api/src/workspace/service.ts apps/site-api/src/workspace/routes.ts apps/site-api/src/workspace/types.ts apps/site-api/src/workspace/synthetic-bill-parser.ts apps/site-api/src/workspace/m64-routes.ts apps/site-api/src/workspace/m65-routes.ts apps/site-api/src/workspace/m66-routes.ts apps/site-api/src/workspace/m66-source-routes.ts apps/site-api/src/workspace/m66-report-routes.ts apps/site-api/src/workspace/m67-routes.ts apps/site-api/src/workspace/m67-report-routes.ts ./apps/site-api/src/workspace/
COPY apps/site-api/src/lib/auth.ts apps/site-api/src/lib/origin-check.ts apps/site-api/src/lib/rate-limit.ts ./apps/site-api/src/lib/
COPY apps/site-api/src/calculation/server.ts apps/site-api/src/calculation/linked_bill_calculation.py apps/site-api/src/calculation/location_based_electricity.py ./apps/site-api/src/calculation/
COPY packages/neuvetra-database/src/index.ts packages/neuvetra-database/src/workspace.ts packages/neuvetra-database/src/hosted.ts packages/neuvetra-database/src/staging-migrations.ts packages/neuvetra-database/src/staging-audit.ts packages/neuvetra-database/src/staging-tls.ts packages/neuvetra-database/src/m58.ts packages/neuvetra-database/src/m59.ts packages/neuvetra-database/src/m60.ts packages/neuvetra-database/src/m61.ts packages/neuvetra-database/src/m64.ts packages/neuvetra-database/src/m64-contract.ts packages/neuvetra-database/src/m65.ts packages/neuvetra-database/src/m65-contract.ts packages/neuvetra-database/src/m65-template.ts packages/neuvetra-database/src/m66-contract.ts packages/neuvetra-database/src/m66-template.ts packages/neuvetra-database/src/m66-fixtures.ts packages/neuvetra-database/src/m67-contract.ts packages/neuvetra-database/src/m67-template.ts packages/neuvetra-database/src/m68-contract.ts packages/neuvetra-database/src/m68-template.ts ./packages/neuvetra-database/src/
COPY packages/neuvetra-database/src/m68.ts packages/neuvetra-database/src/m68-contract.ts packages/neuvetra-database/src/m68-template.ts packages/neuvetra-database/src/m68-report.ts ./packages/neuvetra-database/src/
COPY apps/site-api/src/workspace/m68-routes.ts apps/site-api/src/workspace/m68-report-routes.ts ./apps/site-api/src/workspace/
COPY packages/neuvetra-database/src/m67.ts packages/neuvetra-database/src/m67-report.ts ./packages/neuvetra-database/src/
COPY packages/neuvetra-database/src/m66.ts packages/neuvetra-database/src/m66-sources.ts packages/neuvetra-database/src/m66-report.ts ./packages/neuvetra-database/src/
COPY packages/neuvetra-database/src/migrations/0001_company_workspace.sql packages/neuvetra-database/src/migrations/0002_synthetic_bill_intake.sql packages/neuvetra-database/src/migrations/0003_synthetic_bill_calculation.sql packages/neuvetra-database/src/migrations/0004_inventory_review.sql packages/neuvetra-database/src/migrations/0005_annual_electricity_register.sql packages/neuvetra-database/src/migrations/0006_inventory_evidence_pack.sql packages/neuvetra-database/src/migrations/0007_inventory_draft_report.sql packages/neuvetra-database/src/migrations/0008_inventory_draft_report_review.sql packages/neuvetra-database/src/migrations/0009_private_staging.sql packages/neuvetra-database/src/migrations/0010_manual_electricity_worksheet.sql packages/neuvetra-database/src/migrations/0011_worksheet_reports.sql packages/neuvetra-database/src/migrations/0012_source_electricity_worksheet.sql packages/neuvetra-database/src/migrations/0013_annual_electricity_worksheet.sql packages/neuvetra-database/src/migrations/0014_annual_electricity_evidence.sql ./packages/neuvetra-database/src/migrations/
COPY output/pdf/neuvetra-m55-synthetic-electricity-bill.pdf output/pdf/neuvetra-m66-synthetic-electricity-bill-b.pdf ./output/pdf/
COPY data/synthetic/m58-electricity-register-2023.json data/synthetic/m58-electricity-register-2023.manifest.json ./data/synthetic/
COPY tools/cloud/fixtures/supabase-prod-ca-2021.crt ./tools/cloud/fixtures/
COPY --from=web-build /app/apps/site-web/dist-staging/ ./apps/site-web/dist-staging/
# Import and hash verification happen without credentials or network calls.
RUN bun --version && python --version && bun -e 'await import("./apps/site-api/src/staging/server.ts"); const {verifyStagingAssets}=await import("./apps/site-api/src/staging/assets.ts"); await verifyStagingAssets("/app/apps/site-web/dist-staging");'
USER 10001:10001
EXPOSE 8080
HEALTHCHECK --interval=30s --timeout=20s --start-period=30s --retries=3 CMD ["bun", "-e", "const r=await fetch('http://127.0.0.1:'+(process.env.PORT||'8080')+'/ready',{signal:AbortSignal.timeout(18000)});process.exit(r.ok?0:1)"]
CMD ["bun", "run", "apps/site-api/src/staging/server.ts"]

export function validateAnnualEvidenceReportInput(value: unknown): AnnualEvidenceReportInput {

  if(Object.keys(p).sort().join("|")!==["sourceVersionId","expectedInputSha256","expectedResultSha256","expectedReviewId","expectedReviewSha256","idempotencyKey"].sort().join("|") || typeof p.sourceVersionId!=="string" || !M64_UUID.test(p.sourceVersionId) || typeof p.idempotencyKey!=="string" || !M64_UUID.test(p.idempotencyKey) || typeof p.expectedInputSha256!=="string" || !M64_HASH.test(p.expectedInputSha256) || typeof p.expectedResultSha256!=="string" || !M64_HASH.test(p.expectedResultSha256) || !((p.expectedReviewId===null&&p.expectedReviewSha256===null)||(typeof p.expectedReviewId==="string"&&M64_UUID.test(p.expectedReviewId)&&typeof p.expectedReviewSha256==="string"&&M64_HASH.test(p.expectedReviewSha256)))) throw new AnnualEvidenceReportValidationError("Invalid report request.")
  return value as AnnualEvidenceReportInput
}

export async function readAnnualEvidenceReports(tx:WorkspaceSql,companyId:string):Promise<{list:AnnualEvidenceReportList;bytes:Map<string,Uint8Array>}|null> {
  const gate=await tx.query<{allowed:boolean}>("select neuvetra.lock_annual_electricity_report_read($1) allowed",[companyId])
  if(!gate.rows[0]?.allowed)return null
  const worksheet=await readAnnualElectricityEvidence(tx,companyId)
  if(!worksheet)return null
  const rows=await tx.query<ReportRow>("select * from neuvetra.annual_evidence_reports where company_id=$1 order by created_at,id",[companyId])
  const audits=await tx.query<{report_id:string;actor_id:string;event_meta:unknown;created_at:string}>("select * from neuvetra.annual_evidence_report_audit where company_id=$1",[companyId])
  const fail=()=>{throw new Error("Worksheet report could not be verified.")}
  const iso=(raw:string)=>{const date=new Date(raw);if(!Number.isFinite(date.getTime()))return fail();return date.toISOString()}
  if(audits.rows.length!==rows.rows.length)return fail()
  const reports:AnnualEvidenceReport[]=[], bytes=new Map<string,Uint8Array>()
  for(const row of rows.rows){
    const current=worksheet.versions.find(v=>v.id===row.source_version_id),snapshot=row.source_snapshot
    if(!current || row.company_id!==companyId || !M64_UUID.test(row.id) || !M64_UUID.test(row.created_by) || row.template_version!==M68_TEMPLATE_VERSION || row.template_sha256!==M68_TEMPLATE_SHA256 || row.source_input_sha256!==current.inputSha256 || row.source_result_sha256!==current.resultSha256 || snapshot.id!==current.id || row.review_id!==(snapshot.review?.id??null) || row.review_sha256!==(snapshot.review?.decisionSha256??null))return fail()
    // A previously captured absence remains absent; a captured decision must still resolve exactly.
    const expected={...current,review:snapshot.review===null?null:current.review}
    if(canonical(snapshot)!==canonical(expected))return fail()
    const createdAt=iso(row.created_at)
    if(createdAt<current.createdAt || (snapshot.review && createdAt<snapshot.review.reviewedAt) || (!snapshot.review && current.review && createdAt>current.review.reviewedAt))return fail()
    const built=buildAnnualEvidenceReport({id:row.id,companyId,createdBy:row.created_by,createdAt,source:snapshot})
    if(built.identitySha256!==row.operation_fingerprint || built.reportSha256!==row.report_sha256 || built.bytes.byteLength!==row.report_byte_length || !Buffer.from(built.bytes).equals(Buffer.from(row.report_bytes)))return fail()
    const meta={profile:M68_REPORT_PROFILE,reportId:row.id,sourceVersionId:current.id,inputSha256:current.inputSha256,resultSha256:current.resultSha256,reviewId:row.review_id,reviewSha256:row.review_sha256,templateVersion:M68_TEMPLATE_VERSION,templateSha256:M68_TEMPLATE_SHA256,reportSha256:row.report_sha256,reportByteLength:row.report_byte_length,identitySha256:built.identitySha256}
    const event=audits.rows.filter(a=>a.report_id===row.id)
    if(event.length!==1 || event[0]!.actor_id!==row.created_by || iso(event[0]!.created_at)!==createdAt || canonical(event[0]!.event_meta)!==canonical(meta))return fail()
    reports.push({id:row.id,companyId,profile:M68_REPORT_PROFILE,sourceVersionId:current.id,sourceVersion:current.version,inputSha256:current.inputSha256,resultSha256:current.resultSha256,reviewId:row.review_id,reviewSha256:row.review_sha256,reviewState:!snapshot.review?"unreviewed":snapshot.review.decision==="accept_bounded_internal_draft"?"accepted_bounded_internal_draft":"changes_requested",templateVersion:M68_TEMPLATE_VERSION,templateSha256:M68_TEMPLATE_SHA256,reportSha256:row.report_sha256,reportByteLength:row.report_byte_length,createdBy:row.created_by,createdAt,synthetic:true,complete:false,releaseEligible:false,assurance:"none",source:snapshot})
    bytes.set(row.id,built.bytes)
  }
  return {list:{profile:M68_REPORT_PROFILE,companyId,reports},bytes}
}
